objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed policy, guideline, procedural instruction, or work instruction that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning, and archiving lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The type/level of the document (e.g. Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction).

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: The document type abbreviation included in the document name.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive 4-digit number per document type.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The title of the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. Editing, Released, Out of Force).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version number of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released document version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document version is valid, calculated from Valid From plus period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: The time period for validity check, default 3 years.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: The period for which archived documents are retained before physical deletion, default 10 years.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: The language of the document content.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: The scope or areas of validity of the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: References to other documents or master data.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Referenced IT applications.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies relevant to the document.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document attached to a main document that is subject to its own versioning and is automatically released with the main document release.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: The version number of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the attachment.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A document attachment that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document and does not have its own release cycle; released directly via switches in properties.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal created by authors for changes to an existing released document, managed without affecting the document content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-created request triggered 30 days before document validity expires, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend or revise document validity.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate and archive a released document that no longer has validity, triggering the override workflow process.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated and archived document, created by the Business Admin group.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A group of users defined in the system for assigning read or change authorizations to documents.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the user group.

objs.name: person
objs.description: An individual user in the system who can be assigned roles and authorizations on documents.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: The role assigned to the person (e.g. Reader, Author, Co-Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator).

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of user groups and persons assigned to a document who are automatically informed about releases, maintained per document.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: Distribution by E-mail or Distribution for Acknowledgement.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new document objects.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A signature applied by workflow participants to complete workflow tasks, documented per released version.

attributes.name: signer
attributes.description: The person who applied the signature.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: The time the signature was applied.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is created in the system by attaching a new information object with selection of document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The document type selected during creation.

attributes.name: template
attributes.description: The template selected during creation, if any.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of the document is edited using the implemented editing client in the corresponding Office component.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: The metadata and attributes of the document are maintained or changed via the properties editing dialog.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: The document is automatically and system-supported converted to PDF after saving.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step approval process (Creator - Review - Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first workflow step of the release process.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document content according to technical and/or formal aspects in the review workflow step.

attributes.name: review_result
attributes.description: Positive or rejection.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves the document for distribution in the release workflow step.

attributes.name: release_result
attributes.description: Positive or rejection.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the release workflow, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants.

attributes.name: rejection_step
attributes.description: The step at which rejection occurred (Review or Release).

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and made visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is automatically created when changes are triggered.

attributes.name: trigger
attributes.description: The reason for the new version (content change, attribute change, attachment change, change proposal implementation).

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: An attachment object is created and linked to a main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived with the release of the next main document version.

evts.name: create_additional_information
evts.description: An additional information object is created and added to a document.

evts.name: delete_additional_information
evts.description: An additional information object is directly deleted from a document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is created for an existing released document by a user with author rights.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the completion of an assigned change proposal; the creator receives notification.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system automatically creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the document validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The validity of a document is confirmed and the Valid Until date is updated by the default period.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate and archive a document.

evts.name: declare_override
evts.description: The document and its attachments are declared invalid and archived; all rights except archive group are revoked.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A request for reactivation is created by the Business Admin group for an invalidated document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An invalidated document is reactivated, creating a new version with retained metadata and restored authorizations.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or change authorizations are assigned to a document via user group or person assignment.

attributes.name: authorization_type
attributes.description: Type of authorization assigned (read or change).

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are informed by email notification upon release of a new document version.

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are requested by email to actively confirm acknowledgement upon document release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of the released document version via workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language into which the document is translated.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: A translated language version is checked and released with workflow support, making it visible to authorized readers.

evts.name: physical_deletion
evts.description: After the archive period has expired, documents are physically deleted from the system.

o2o.description: An Attachment belongs to and is controlled by a main Document.
Additional Information is supplementary content attached to a Document.
A Change Proposal belongs to and is displayed within a specific Document.
A Request for Validity Extension is linked to the Document to be checked.
A Request for Override is created for a specific Document to be invalidated.
A Request for Reactivation references the invalidated Document to be reactivated.
A Distribution List is maintained for a specific Document.
A Distribution List includes User Groups to be notified about document releases.
A Distribution List includes Persons to be notified about document releases.
A Document Template can be used when creating a new Document of the corresponding type.
A Document can reference another Document.
